title: Site Engineer
screening_questions: What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a site engineer?
content_text:
SACYR is a global infrastructure group listed on the IBEX 35, Spain's benchmark stock market index. Operating in more than 15 countries across four continents, we deliver innovative, high-value projects in strategic sectors including concession-based infrastructure, construction, healthcare and integrated water management.
With almost 20 years of experience in Western Australia, SACYR has established a strong presence in the local market and continues to play an important role in delivering major infrastructure projects.
With a growing pipeline of opportunities and a long-term commitment to Australia, we are excited about the future and looking to welcome talented professionals to join our expanding team.
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Site Engineer to join our team on the New Mandurah Hospital project in Western Australia.
Based in Mandurah, you will play a key role in delivering this state-of-the-art healthcare facility, providing on-site engineering expertise, technical support and construction coordination to ensure works are delivered safely, efficiently and to the highest standards.
This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated and driven engineer to further develop their career while contributing to a landmark infrastructure project that will make a lasting difference to the Western Australian community.
Your Responsibilities
- Coordinate and manage construction engineering activities to ensure works are delivered in accordance with approved designs, specifications and project requirements.
- Provide technical support and engineering advice to project teams and subcontractors.
- Assist with project planning, programming and forecasting activities.
- Monitor and report on construction progress, compliance, project performance and risk management.
- Undertake cost control, estimating and budget monitoring to support project delivery objectives.
- Review and verify subcontractor claims, variations and progress against contractual requirements.
- Maintain project documentation, drawing registers and records management systems.
- Monitor compliance with safety, environmental and quality requirements, ensuring appropriate controls are implemented.
- Support the preparation of construction methodologies, work packs, reports and tender documentation.
- Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, subcontractors and client representatives to achieve successful project outcomes.
About You
To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
- A minimum of 2 years' experience as a Site Engineer or in a similar role within the construction, building or infrastructure sectors, preferably on large and complex building projects.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating construction activities and managing project delivery requirements.
- Experience in project planning, progress reporting, forecasting and cost control.
- The ability to identify and manage project risks and develop practical solutions.
- Strong communication, teamwork and stakeholder management skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant project management software.
What do we offer?
• Personal and professional development through continuous training programs, opportunities for internal and international mobility, volunteering initiatives, and healthy lifestyle habits.
• The opportunity to be part of a dynamic work environment guided by three core principles collaborative intelligence, excellence, and comprehensive social responsibility.
For us, the journey is just as important as the destination. That is why we learn every day from the richness that comes from the diversity of the people who make up this great team.
We embrace innovation, new experiences, unity, and a strong commitment to your talent. Always in the best company and with a spirit of continuous improvement. Together, we are stronger.
Set the course for your future. Set your #RumboSacyr.

content_text:
On board a vessel like a cruise ship, trawler, oil tanker, or merchant liner, or commercial ship, there are various engineer jobs, one of the lower level being the Third Engineer or the Fourth Engineer. This is the entry level position, and you will be designated the lower jobs on board the vessel. You will help the rest of the crew to perform repairs, maintenance tasks, and other duties for the ship’s engine room and propulsion systems.
The First and Second Assistant, the DDE and
The Chief will undertake the main duties on board. You have to keep your work area clean and safe, take orders from the first assistants, give accurate reports, and endure spending time away from home for weeks if not months at a time.
